set.name: Dragonlands: Uncharted Realms
set.theme: Mid-set update to Dragonlands. Traits added: Darkflight, Lagoon, Monolith, Prodigy. Removed: Legend, Revel, Trainer. New 3-cost Dragons.

notes.itemScope: Item and augment membership comes from the "TFTSet7_Stage2" item/augment lists in the patch 13.11 CDragon file. Values come from the patch 12.22 file when the item exists there, else from 13.11. The list is the full pool the game data allows for the set mode, so it includes items obtainable only through augments, anvils or special rounds.
notes.abilityValues: Computed with 100 AP and no items; star order 1/2/3. Unresolved placeholders listed per ability.
notes.augmentTiers: Inferred from icon art suffix or apiName; approximate.

mechanics: Three Treasure Dragon versions: Chaos Dragon 30% of games, Order Dragon 30% (guarantees a Radiant item), classic 40%. All players get the same version. [12.17 notes]

Dragons are no longer unique (still 2 slots). Dragon became a 1/2/3/4/5 trait: (1) HP, (2) +20 Armor & MR, (3) +10% damage, (4) +1 army size, (5) +10% attack speed. CDragon at 12.22 shows a sixth breakpoint ("Dragons ascend"). [12.17 notes, CDragon]
Dragons cost 6/7/8 gold at tier 3/4/5. All-Dragon carousel past stage 5 chance 5% to 15%. [12.17 notes]
Armory selection menus get a 1-second input lockout. [12.17 notes]
